tasks.summary: Removed system variant from decisionSourceSchema. No callers in repo. typecheck + tests/coach.test.ts green.

Added checkpoint.frameCounter (default 0), replaced nextFrameScope with ensureFrameCounter migration helper that backfills from stack scopes + scoped output keys when counter is zero. Hot path is now a pure increment. Added sibling-ref test asserting frameCounter==2 and scope f2.

Added superRefine to checkpointSchema asserting position.graph matches stack.at(-1).child.graphId | graphSource.graphId | rootGraph. Added test that mutates a checkpoint on disk and asserts readCheckpoint throws on position.graph.
npm run build + npm test (62 tests) green. No stale nextFrameScope or 'system' references in src/tests.
